name: pi-telegram-tts
description: TTS synthesis provider for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Registers a synthesis provider against the bridge's public voice API so voice.sendTranscript and getVoicePromptContribution both work (the v0.19.0 outboundHandlers[0].template path silently drops the transcript). v0.2.0 subsumes the pi-voice-telegram-scripts package — the tts-{minimax,openai}.mjs scripts are now bundled here and exposed via the package's bin field (tts-minimax, tts-openai on PATH after `npm install`). Same scripts, same auth resolution, same ffmpeg output; the only delta vs the v0.1.0 provider is the bundled scripts.
